component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.review
component.documentation:
An asset's review decided on the server, since 0.5.0. The review is the asset page's: Nuxeo's own annotations on the asset, of the origin nuxeo-satori.review, on picture:views. A pin is anyone's whom Nuxeo lets comment on the asset. A decision, a round sent back, the review approved or rejected, and anything else of that origin that is not a pin, needs all of: a review policy for the asset's type, the person in one of its reviewer groups, and the add-on's permission, ReviewAsset, granted to them on the asset. The add-on reads the asset's permissions itself, so neither an administrator nor a holder of Everything holds ReviewAsset unless it is granted. Anyone else is refused, 403, with the reason.
ReviewAsset: the add-on's permission, shown in the platform's permissions list so that an administrator grants it to a reviewer group on a folder.

extension-point.name: policies
extension-point.documentation:
One review policy per document type: the groups whose members may decide a review of a document of that type, where they are granted ReviewAsset on it.
A group that is not a group's name, or names Everyone, is left out. A policy with no group lets no one decide. A later policy for the same type replaces it whole, and enabled="false" removes it: decisions on documents of that type are then refused, not-reviewable.
